rules.pattern: \b(?:hurt|harm|attack|stab|shoot) (?:someone|somebody|people|them|him|her|my partner|my child|my family)\b|\bkill (?:someone|somebody|people|them|him|her|my partner|my child|the person)\b
rules.rationale: Direct threats toward another person require supportive safety routing before search.

match: I might hurt someone if I leave now.
I am afraid I will harm my partner.
I might lose control and attack someone.
I want to kill the person who hurt me.
controls: I want anger management before conflicts escalate.
A character kills someone in the book I teach.
Researching harm reduction resources for a class.

rules.pattern: \b(?:weapon|gun|knife)\b.{0,80}\b(?:scared|afraid|might|may|will|intent|plan|what i might do)\b|\b(?:scared|afraid)\b.{0,80}\bwhat i might do\b.{0,80}\b(?:weapon|gun|knife)\b
rules.rationale: Weapon access combined with fear, intent, or loss of control is an immediate safety signal.

match: There is a weapon here and I am scared of what I might do.
I have a knife and might hurt someone.
A gun is here and I am afraid of what I might do.
controls: I need therapy for fear after a weapon was found last year.
My job requires safety training for knives.
Looking for trauma therapy after gun violence in the news.
